business_summary: Winner Technology Co., Inc. provides artificial intelligence (AI) and big data application solutions in China. The company offers digital marketplace solutions, including AI customer flow solutions, big data service solutions for shopping malls, AI-powered indoor navigation systems, and metaverse construction operations programs; and digital store solutions, such as Smart Stores AI customer flow solutions, big data service solutions for brand stores, smart store AI remote inspection solutions, and intelligence store AI business display solutions. It also provides digital government solutions comprising city/municipalities commerce big data platforms; urban/city public space analysis platforms; government hotline data governance and analysis platforms; government online-offline Shanghai; digital comprehensive research and analysis platform; and platform for integrated governance and application development for government data. In addition, the company offers digital political solutions, such as smart court systems, smart mediation rooms, intelligent litigation service centers, electronic file single set systems, and electronic files digital number lifecycle management solutions. Its products are used for digital shopping malls, digital stores, digital government and digital law and law. Further, the company is involved in the provision of technical, technology development, technical consultation, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion services, as well as information system integration, data processing, and data processing and storage support services; retail of computer hardware and software and auxiliary equipment; and sale of office and communication equipment. Winner Technology Co., Inc. was formerly known as Winner Information Technology Co., Inc. and changed its name to Winner Technology Co., Inc. in August 2018. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
